Version A — the labeled "Read later" button that flips to "In Read later" — feels the most natural to me. The words spell out exactly what tapping it does, so there's no guessing, whereas the bare checkbox and the ribbon icon (Versions B and C) leave me a little unsure what they mean until I try them. So A is my pick.

Your assumptions are right: having "Read later" always sitting in the sidebar with a count so I can see how many I've stacked up is just what I'd want, and I like that marking one keeps it in the main library too — it's a "come back to this" flag, not moving it out of sight. Good.
